name: claude-code-tooling-skills
description: Eleven Claude Code skills for keeping a Claude Code setup safe and tidy: review third-party skills before install, lint and evaluate your own skill descriptions, audit the context budget, build least-privilege permissions, review the sandbox settings, preflight unattended runs for permission prompts, review subagent tool scope, author and test hooks, and find skill collisions and portability problems.

plugins.name: cc-setup-tooling
plugins.description: Eleven skills, each with a tested standard-library script over local files: skill-supply-chain-review, skill-description-linter, skill-trigger-eval, context-budget-audit, permissions-builder, sandbox-config-review, unattended-run-preflight, subagent-tool-scope-review, hook-author, skill-collision-check and skill-portability-check. They drive skill-scan-gate, cc-plugin-lock, claude-perm-sim, claude-mcp-allow and cc-hooks where those are installed. No network.
